author: Zephyr I
title: NodIl bottleneck ratio=0.20 replicate — BASE_SEED=7 (std-width d=5, double-step LN-ConvLSTM)
abstract: Replicate the nodil-bottleneck configuration with bottleneck_ratio fixed to 0.20 (best on BASE_SEED=42, ID 285=85.2). Std-width 32/64 CNN, main-conv dilation d=5, double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64), 1-head AttnPool, AdamW+clip; no FE. BASE_SEED=7.
